classified.result: Official own-network EWE Go Ladetarif is 0.52 EUR/kWh for AC and DC with no monthly base fee and no blocking fee on EWE Go stations. Official current FAQ states ad-hoc without tariff is 0.84 EUR/kWh. Partner 0.62 EUR/kWh and partner blocking fee are eMSP/roaming only and excluded from the physical CPO.

Primary current Connect ME tariff is exact at 0.49 EUR/kWh AC up to 49 kW, 0.57 EUR/kWh DC 50-75 kW and 0.69 EUR/kWh HPC 76-400 kW, with no blocking fee. Ad-hoc values are published only as maxima (0.58/0.69/0.79) and exact price is station-scoped; 31 canonical DE*MER EVSEs belong to minority physical operators and remain fail-closed.

Primary network tariff is exact: 0.38 EUR/kWh plus 0.60 EUR/h for sessions started 20:00-04:00 or 1.20 EUR/h for sessions started 04:00-20:00, with no monthly fee. All 726 canonical DE*EZE EVSEs are AC/eze.network. Runtime/data schema does not safely encode a session-start-window-selected hourly component, so no flattened tariff is emitted.
